about: What the picture finder was measured to do for each kind of object, and the highest answer level that evidence supports today. Read by src/services/answer_levels.py; rules in docs/rules/ANSWER_LEVELS_RULES.md. Every number was measured on 2026-10-11 with YOLOE-11s (yoloe-11s-seg) visual prompts and scored as AP50 against people's boxes. Each 'evidence' selects the rows of answer_levels_evidence.json (copied from the measuring session's results) that a value is the mean of; src/services/test_answer_levels.py checks every value, picture count and finder size against them. The scripts and pictures are NOT in this repository, so the numbers cannot be re-run from the repo yet. view is which way the measured pictures looked (oblique: photos taken at an angle, the tower photos; nadir: straight down, orthophoto and UAV tiles), read from each dataset's description; image_px is the long side of the measured pictures as given; finder_input_px is the size the finder read them at (it scales the long side to that size). size_evidence names the sets of marked pictures in answer_levels_evidence.json that the size gate's floor is taken from.
